purpose: Remaps every question in the live CIA Part 1 bank from the incorrect production five-domain scheme onto the six official IIA CIA Part 1 (2025 syllabus) domains, and derives the authoring top-up specification from that remap. This file is the spec: any number quoted about the remap must be read from here, not restated from prose.
syllabus: IIA CIA Part 1, 2025 syllabus (verified current as of Aug 2026). Six domains; 125 questions / 150 minutes.

coverage.note: Covers the live bank exactly. The 2026-08-11 dedupe backup deleted 255 docs, 100 of which were the duplicate exam; none of those 100 appear here (225 - 100 = 125).

howToRead.offBlueprint: true means the question is real, well-written CIA content but is NOT reachable by any CIA Part 1 objective (it is Part 2 material). Its `objective` field records where it was previously parked and is NOT an assertion of blueprint fit. Off-blueprint records are excluded from every on-blueprint count and from all gap math. Do not serve them as domain drill items for the objective shown.
howToRead.confidence: high = unambiguous fit; medium = defensible but arguable, see `note`; low = parked / off-blueprint, see `note`.
howToRead.previousObjective: Present only where this pass corrected an objective code within an otherwise correct domain.

distributionRaw.basis: All 125 mapped records, including off-blueprint items. Provided for reconciliation only. DO NOT drive authoring from this table.

distributionOnBlueprint.basis: The 125 records minus the 17 off-blueprint items. THIS is the real state of Part 1 coverage and the only table the top-up may be derived from.

topUp.correction: Any earlier claim that this bank is over-weighted on Foundations is BACKWARDS. On-blueprint Foundations is 15, at or below its 125-question target of 19. And Proficiency and Due Professional Care is not short by 7 — on-blueprint it holds only 7 of a 23-question target, roughly double the previously stated hole.
topUp.roundingNote: Each targetCount is its blueprint percentage of the stated bank size, rounded independently, so the target column sums slightly above the bank size. Treat targets as +/-1.
topUp.negativeGapNote: A negative gap means the domain already exceeds its blueprint share. Governance, Risk Management, and Control and Fraud Risks cannot be brought to weight by authoring; either accept the overage, grow the bank (see atBankSize150), or retire items. Author nothing new against a negative gap.
priorityOrder: Proficiency and Due Professional Care - largest gap by far, and 9 of its 16 mapped items are parked Part 2 content, so the drillable pool is nearly empty.
Quality Assurance and Improvement Program - only 4 on-blueprint items against a 7% domain, and IV.B has zero.
Foundations of Internal Auditing - 8 of 23 mapped items are parked; the domain is NOT over-supplied.
Independence and Objectivity - modest gap, but II.D has zero coverage.
Governance, Risk Management, and Control - over weight overall, but V.D has zero coverage and must be authored regardless.
Fraud Risks - over weight; author nothing new.

objectiveCoverage.basis: Objective-level counts. Domain totals hide empty objectives, so this list, not the domain table, governs what must be authored.
emptyObjectives: IV.B (Reporting QAIP results to the board)
